q1_issues.issue: fever_causing_spider_bite is a kind symbol invented out of the relative clause — no such compound appears in the surface, and Compound concepts licenses fusion only for compounds actually present in the text, so this fabricates a sub-kind the sentence never names.

(Cause fever_causing_spider_bite fever) hangs the relative clause's content on that invented kind, whereas a relative clause takes the ordinary event form / rule-premise treatment, and the kind-relation license requires bare kind-denoting NPs on both sides.

The sentence's actual claim ("are rare") is asserted of the invented kind, so it is recorded only under a symbol nothing else in the KB can reach — the restriction "that cause fever" is not recoverable as a relation between spider_bite and fever.

q2_gaps: restrictive relative clause narrowing a bare-plural kind subject whose main predicate is a non-distributing KindProperty ("Spider bites that cause fever are rare") — relative clauses are supported only as rule premises / reified events, and a kind-level KindProperty cannot be a rule conclusion, so the restricted sub-kind is inexpressible

adversative discourse marker "though" relating two clauses that reify no eventualities (a KindProperty statement and a kind-level capability property) — the connective rule needs two reified endpoints, and this is not the defeasible-exception case that consumes the cue either
notes: Sentence 2 is clean: the capability generic correctly keys on the modal rather than the indefinite determiner, and cause_death is decomposed exactly as a compound action inside (can ...). The head Cause is the form the kind-relation license permits — the defect is its invented first argument, not the head.
